review_locator: PMCID:PMC4281037, IL-23-IL-17 immune axis: Discovery, Mechanistic Understanding, and Clinical Testing; PMCID:PMC7605919, GM-CSF: A Promising Target in Inflammation and Autoimmunity
primary_title: The encephalitogenicity of T(H)17 cells is dependent on IL-1- and IL-23-induced production of the cytokine GM-CSF
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-23 induces GM-CSF/CSF2 production in Th17 cells and that this output is required for heightened autoimmune encephalitogenicity.
limitations_preserved: Preserve the IL-23 heterodimer, IL-1/TGF-beta co-cytokine and mouse Th17/EAE context; CSF2 is a measured output bridge and does not establish a universal direct promoter mechanism.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4281037, IL-23-IL-17 immune axis: Discovery, Mechanistic Understanding, and Clinical Testing; PMCID:PMC2754144, Signal transduction and Th17 cell differentiation
primary_title: Interleukin-23-induced interleukin-23 receptor subunit expression is mediated by the Janus kinase/signal transducer and activation of transcription pathway in human CD4 T cells
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-23 upregulates IL-23R and IL-12Rbeta1 expression in human CD4-positive T cells through a JAK/STAT-sensitive response, establishing positive feedback on receptor competence.
limitations_preserved: Preserve human CD4-positive T-cell and SUPT-1 context and IL-23 receptor-subunit positive feedback; expression evidence does not establish direct IL23R promoter occupancy or SCI specificity.
